name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: Refuse note creates and updates whose path leaves the project by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1837
* feat(mcp): shared parameter types, refusals and resolver for bm_* tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1835
* feat(mcp): bm_read, bm_list, bm_find, bm_search, bm_context by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1836
* feat(mcp): add bm_write, bm_edit, bm_move and bm_delete by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1838
* feat(mcp): add bm_project, bm_project_delete and bm_schema by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1839
* feat(mcp): bm_man and manual pages for the 1.0 tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1844
* feat(cli): redesign bm doctor as a report with suggested fixes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1799
* fix: clean up a superseded move's old file by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1847
* fix(core): defer note promotions that would roll back to a superseded version by @groksrc in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1825
* fix(mcp): refuse create_memory_project path mismatch by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1846
* refactor(mcp): migrate consumers and documentation to 1.0 tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1849
* fix(core): upgrade FastAPI and preserve read-cache identities by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1854
* fix(ci): shard full test suites and preserve local fast-test by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1856
* fix(ci): correct platform assertions and isolate wiki CLI tests by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1863
* fix(mcp): correct manual tool results and cover deferred writes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1864
* fix(core): recover SQLite index rebuilds and large vector deletions by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1865
* fix(sync): catch up newly watched projects during ignored activity by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1866
* fix(mcp): align recovery guidance and manuals with bm tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1868
* docs(core): add unreleased 1.0 changes to the changelog by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1871
* fix(core): keep wiki projections moving past reserved identities by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1875
* fix(api): reject malformed memory JSON before writing notes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1876
* feat: return the file paths a chat import wrote by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1878
* fix(core): preserve title ranking with metadata filters by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1882
* build(deps): make LiteLLM an explicit optional extra by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1883
* refactor(mcp): retire the redundant legacy tool surface by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1881
* fix(core): re-embed relation sources after forward-reference resolution by @remote-controlled-man in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1884
* fix(api): return 400 for malformed memory-context locators by @remote-controlled-man in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1885
* docs: add bm-agent(3) for the hosted agent tool by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1917
* fix(core): escape literal directory prefixes before moves by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1915
* fix(core): bound ChatGPT mapping graph traversal by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1916
* fix(core): avoid quadratic section heading suffix copies by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1920
* fix(core): enforce resolved project root ancestry by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1921
* fix(cli): skip file symlinks in legacy directory uploads by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1922
* fix(core): bound find-replace output before allocation by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1923
* fix(cli): create rclone credentials with private permissions by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1924
* fix(core): make atomic staging private before writing by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1925
* fix(core): bound Markdown directive whitespace scanning by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1926
* fix(core): bound CSV preview before wide-row padding by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1927
* fix(cli): validate normalized upload destinations before dispatch by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1928
* fix(core): preserve configured project root during moves by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1930
* fix(core): enforce project boundaries at import and storage sinks by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1931
* refactor(core): share project path validation contracts by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1932
* fix(mcp): require explicit project scope for note tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1934
* fix(core): reject YAML aliases and merge expansion in notes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1933
* fix(core): match nested directory ignore rules by ancestry by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1929
* docs: bm-agent(3) takes a required project, like the note tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1936
* fix(mcp): honor project constraint in JSON project list by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1937
* fix(cli): prompt for cloud API key instead of requiring argv by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1938
* fix(core): cap ZIP import and search query input sizes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1939
* fix(mcp): report a timed-out query as a ToolError by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1942
* feat(cli)!: bm tool mirrors the bm_* MCP tools by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1943
* fix(core): apply directory path rules to their files and skip a BOM in ignore files by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1949
* fix(core): normalize OpenAI-compatible embedding vectors by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1948
* refactor(mcp): remove retired tool modules nothing calls by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1944
* refactor(mcp): remove the retired write_note tool by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1947
* fix(sync): keep file events across watcher reloads by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1951
* docs(core): list only registered tools in section 3 of the manual by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1952
* feat(cli)!: remove legacy cloud sync and bisync by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1953
* fix(core): repair and report entities missing search rows by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1954
* fix(core): rank an exact title match first in title search by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1957
* test(mcp): port project management tests to bm_project by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1961
* refactor(mcp): fold schema tools into bm_schema by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1959
* refactor(mcp): port context and recent-activity tests to bm_context and bm_project by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1962
* refactor(mcp): remove read_note, edit_note, workspaces and chatgpt tool modules by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1964
* fix(core): own startup index tasks and remove flaky test causes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1967
* refactor(mcp): port search tests to bm_search and remove search_notes by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1963
* refactor(cli)!: rebuild cat/grep/ls/find on bm_* tools and remove tail by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1960
* fix(integrations): make the OpenClaw plugin work on OpenClaw 2026.10 by @groksrc in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1966
* chore(ci): run coverage over the same four suites as just test by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1969
* docs(mcp): describe bm_agent run on nothing, a note, or a folder by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1970
* fix(sync): keep watching when one project directory is missing by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1971
* fix(core): make "a AND NOT b" search work on SQLite by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1972
* fix(mcp): tidy tool messages found in the 1.0 live test by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1974
* docs(core): changelog for v1.0.0 by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1977
* chore(core): release v1.0.0 by @phernandez in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1978

## New Contributors
* @remote-controlled-man made their first contribution in https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/pull/1884

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory/compare/v0.24.1...v1.0.0
